resource_and_timeout_bounds.retry_semantics: No automatic retry. A failed attempt-001 is immutable and any future retry requires a newly authorized attempt identifier.

stop_and_failure_rules: Any command exit code other than zero stops the packet; no later command runs.
Any redirect, non-HTTPS request, host/path outside the exact allowlist, authentication challenge, cookie requirement, or fallback request stops the packet.
Archive byte count, official MD5, or exact checksum-sidecar body mismatch stops before extraction.
No missing or extra ZIP member, unsafe path, duplicate/case collision, link, unsupported file type, reparse point, overwrite, or target escape is tolerated.
Any raw schema, cardinality, user/item domain, duplicate user-item pair, row, field, ID-map, output-set, or projection-digest mismatch stops before admission.
A failure never promotes partial bytes into the raw or atomic final directories.
No checksum is repaired, inferred, substituted, or accepted from a mirror.
No repository-carried or RecBole S3 atomic file is substituted for the GroupLens-derived output.
Unexpected ambiguity returns to central R6-G0/R6-C1 review; it is not solved by changing the command packet during execution.
Every curl argv must begin after curl.exe with literal --disable --proxy ""; any default curl config or ambient proxy route fails static validation.
